description: Na₅GdO₄ is pyrite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.41 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.82 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent GdO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.49 Å. Gd is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted GdO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.20 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Gd atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Gd atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Gd atom to form corner-sharing ONa₅Gd octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-51°.
